correctness.rationale: For r<min(m,n), any r-tuple contains fewer than m points and fewer than n lines, so its support is vacuously I-closed. Conant–Kruckman Proposition 2.14 identifies acl with I-closure and Corollary 2.15 characterizes complete types by marked closure; every finite bipartite pattern of this small size embeds into the existentially closed universal class, so all patterns occur. Choosing point coordinates p and their p(r-p) cross incidences gives a_r=Σ_p C(r,p)2^{p(r-p)}; equality partitions contribute Stirling transform b_r=Σ_k S(r,k)a_k. Verified independent exact integer sequences through r=7 and direct enumeration through r=5. Source Remark 3.4 gives uncountably many types in arity m+n; countable-language upper bound makes it continuum. No extension of the formula beyond r<min(m,n).
